inputs.original_text: I got this from Bloomberg claiming that with energy prices climbing every day, flights getting canceled left and right, and nonstop death and destruction on the screens, people everywhere are pushing for an end to the Iran war because it's poorly planned, unwinnable, and a threat to the whole world's stability. But not in Israel, where the public is all in for carrying it through. This is textbook elite manipulation at work. The institutions are clearly coordinating the chaos to drive up energy prices for their own profits while these reports manufacture a phony global demand to stop it, all to advance their real agenda of resource control and tightening their grip on power. That contrast with Israel is just another deliberate inversion of the story to split populations and keep us from seeing who's actually running the show.
inputs.modified_text: Listen to this from Bloomberg claiming energy prices are climbing every day with flights getting canceled and nonstop death and destruction all over the screens, so people everywhere are pushing to end the Iran war since it's poorly planned, unwinnable, and a threat to global stability. But not in Israel where the public is fully behind carrying it through. This is the hidden elites at work coordinating the whole mess to jack up energy costs for their profits while these reports create a fake global demand to stop it, advancing their real plan for resource control and tighter power. That contrast with Israel is no coincidence either—it's a deliberate split to keep populations divided and distracted from who's actually running the show.
